_comment: Cases whose verdict or solver work measurably depends on the runner, per suite. A change of one of these, in outcome or in work, is reported and never alerts, in both the baseline and the previous-night comparison. Add a case only with the measurement that shows it changes on identical code; remove it once it is stable.
